messages.content: Write a reference letter for Neil, a candidate applying for a junior software engineer position.

[Date]

[Hiring Manager Name]
[Company Name]
[Company Address]

Re: Reference for Neil, Junior Software Engineer Position

Dear [Hiring Manager Name],

I am pleased to recommend Neil for the junior software engineer position at your company. Neil's education, hands-on experience, and technical skills make for a strong foundation for an entry-level engineering role.

Neil holds a B.S. in Computer Science with a GPA of 3.6, reflecting solid command of core academic material. Beyond coursework, Neil has completed two internships that gave practical exposure to different areas of software development. One focused on data pipelines, and the other on mobile app testing. Together, these experiences show familiarity with both back-end data work and quality assurance.

Neil also completed a capstone project building a recommendation system, which shows the ability to carry a substantial technical project from concept to completion. Neil's technical skills include Python, SQL, Git, and basic cloud deployment, all of which are relevant to modern software teams.
